newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks sink over 100 points as bonds slide.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks sink over 100 points as bonds slide.

text.p: Wall Street stocks sank over 100 points shortly after the market open on Friday, hurt by steep declines in bond prices which revived lurking market concerns about the possibility of higher rates.

In early trade, the Dow Jones Industrial shed 101 points, or 1.23 percent, at 8,086, prompting the New York Stock Exchange to set curbs on index-arbitrage trading six minutes after the open. It set sidecar curbs at 0915 EDT/1315 GMT.
